source: build/frame_v4_hudfix_candidate_8881.omtc (keyframe 8881) -- 4-vertex DRAW_PRIMITIVE FVF=0x152 records matched against assets/native/level1_map_coverage.json by translation cluster
rationale: Every entry replaces a native 3D tree mesh with a camera-facing quad of the size the captured frame uses for that tree. The capture renders all in-frustum trees as single 4-vertex billboards (verified in Phase 0 diff: 12/12 capture-matched tree drawcalls have vtx_count=4 and zero local Z range). The native fallback was an 8-38 vertex 3D leafy mesh, which already used the same texture (Phase 3 overrides) but kept the wrong silhouette. Replacing the mesh with the quad closes the foreground-composition gap called out as Phase 5 in docs/native_vs_capture_8881_plan.md.
size_units: world-space (OMT units). The captured quad's local extent in X/Y is the value below; Z extent is always 0 (flat). Native consumes (size, size) into renderer_draw_billboard as (width, height).
y_pivot: The native placement Y is 0 (ground). The captured quad has Y range ~ ±size/2 around its world translation; to keep the billboard's base on the ground we render with center_y = size/2.

overrides.rationale: drawcall 3331 quad half-extent 225 (full 450). Texture matches existing Phase 3 override; size measured directly from FVF152 vertex data.
drawcall 3369 quad half-extent 350 (full 700). Largest tree billboard in the frame.
drawcall 3330 quad half-extent 300 (full 600). Cluster shared with treebranch03 -- same size used for the sibling override.
ambiguous cluster shared with tree32 (same drawcall 3330); use the measured 600 size.
ambiguous cluster shared with tree01 (same drawcall 3331); use the measured 450 size. Already a '2D_' prefix in OMT, so the billboard interpretation is canonical.

deferred.rationale: These tree-named meshes are present in level1.omt but were NOT drawn in keyframe 8881's capture. We have no measured size for them; defer until a future keyframe surfaces a 4-vertex drawcall at their world translation.
